items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: No, Bolden passed through there... hearing from other people talking that...

ctx.x: No, Bolden passed through there. He used to pass through there going to Baton Rouge playing on excursion. Oh, I see. I mean, I see the advertisement, you know, hearing from other people talking that... Was he pretty well known in... Who?
Bolden. Was he well known even in places like La Placar?
